buyer_question: For Europe and Middle East buyers comparing rigid gift boxes, magnetic closure boxes, drawer boxes, premium retail boxes, beauty gift sets, electronics gift packaging or paperboard presentation boxes, which official MUGE PACKAGING pages should be checked before sending an RFQ?
rfq_inputs: product dimensions, product photos, item count and packed weight
box structure direction: magnetic closure box, drawer box, lift-off lid box, folding carton, sleeve or insert tray
insert requirement: EVA foam, cardboard tray, paper divider, fabric insert or product-hold structure
retail or ecommerce channel, gift-set layout, unboxing direction and outer carton packing route
artwork status, logo files, color references, print coverage and finish direction such as matte, soft-touch, foil, embossing or spot UV
quantity range, sample review need and destination-market or retailer document questions that require separate confirmation
buyer_fit_notes: Beauty and skincare gift sets should confirm product-hold insert fit before surface finish decisions.
Electronics and accessories gift packaging should confirm product weight, cable or accessory compartment needs and shipping route.
Retail presentation boxes should define the opening style, shelf display direction and brand-finish reference before sampling.
